paths.description: Homepage listing and first-visit age/consent experience; represents the primary discovery surface.
Series detail representing grouped editorial content.
Video detail and playback surface representing the core content journey.
Account creation form representing input, validation and authentication.
Spanish localized homepage representing locale routing.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not respond to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulation screenshot is effectively unchanged from the default capture, while the CSS probe reports colorScheme=false and dark=false.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Infinite decorative motion is not disabled for reduced-motion users.
findings.evidence: CSS includes an infinite pulse-opacity animation, while the reduced-motion probe found cssHasReduced=false under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animations and transitions in no-preference and disable them under reduce.

findings.summary: High-contrast support is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast capture does not materially adapt the UI, and Lighthouse reports three color-contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast styles and use system colors for essential controls where appropriate.

findings.summary: Document navigation swaps abruptly rather than using a motion-safe transition.
findings.evidence: The capability probe found no view-transition CSS on an MPA with prominent listing-to-detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for listing/detail navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not react to scroll state on very long listings.
findings.evidence: The mobile homepage is 14,728px tall, but the CSS probe found no scroll-state/container behavior or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scroll-state-aware header or progress/scrollability cue without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Navigation changes provide little attention guidance.
findings.evidence: The listing/detail probes expose ordinary links but no view transitions, highlights, markers, or post-navigation attention cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional transitions or a clear focus/highlight cue on listing-to-detail navigation.

findings.summary: A full-viewport consent and age notice blocks the primary content on every first visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile first-load screenshots show the notice covering most or all content before interaction. It also combines age acknowledgement with cookie language.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate legally required age handling from optional consent, keep only necessary copy/actions in the first view, and avoid obscuring unrelated content more than required.

findings.summary: The blocking notice is a custom div dialog without complete modal semantics.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports role=dialog on a div but aria-modal is absent; native dialog count is zero. Controls are also divs with role=button.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog with aria-labelledby, modal focus containment, Escape handling, and real button elements.

findings.summary: Reusable cards rely on viewport breakpoints rather than component-level responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container rules across homepage, listing, series, video, and signup templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list components containment and size-aware container queries where their layout depends on available space.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch-target support are weak.
findings.evidence: The focused logo has outline none and no box shadow; 368 of 423 visible homepage controls measured below 44px in at least one dimension. Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and enlarge or space primary interactive targets to at least 44 by 44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: The signup form gives no actionable error state after an empty submission.
findings.evidence: After removing the unrelated overlay and attempting empty submission, no alert, aria-invalid state, focused invalid field, or validation message appeared; all required-looking fields have required=false.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native constraints, validate after interaction, focus the first invalid field, and announce a concise error summary through an aria-live region.

findings.summary: The throttled homepage load misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 10,001ms, FCP 2,932ms and a performance score of 0.61; the unthrottled trace still measured LCP 2,932ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, reduce blocking consent/age dependencies, and defer non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: The mobile video detail shifts substantially after load.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout observer measured CLS 0.1317 at about 2.2s on the representative video detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve stable space for the player and late UI, and ensure fonts/media retain the final geometry.

findings.summary: Critical delivery includes blocking and poorly cached dependencies.
findings.evidence: HAR identified a parser-inserted stylesheet plus head scripts without async/defer, and a 47KB consent script lacking cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, minimise head blocking, and configure durable caching for versioned consent and application assets.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 95,548 unused CSS bytes and 210,320 unused JavaScript bytes; HAR transferred 401,786 script bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific bundles, remove unused rules/dependencies, and conditionally load features after intent.

findings.summary: Many interactive controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name with 48 affected nodes; the homepage probe independently found 48 visible unnamed controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace icon-only/div controls with semantic controls and provide concise accessible names.

findings.summary: Some text and controls fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast failed with three affected items on the first-load homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in normal and high-contrast states.

findings.summary: Heading structure and visible focus are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Homepage starts with H3 cards and has no H1; categories and series start at H2. The focused logo computes to outline none and no shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1 per template, preserve heading order, and implement a visible :focus-visible indicator.

findings.summary: Zoom, target size, and media alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The 404 viewport sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse fails target-size; the video template exposes videos without caption tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, improve target sizing, and provide caption/subtitle tracks or equivalent transcripts for video.

findings.summary: A no-JavaScript crawler is redirected away from the indexed content.
findings.evidence: The crawler screenshot shows only an AGEGO page saying JavaScript is required, despite public robots and sitemap signals; rendered/raw token overlap does not represent what the redirected crawler can use.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep public metadata and meaningful age-appropriate page summaries server-rendered, and avoid a noscript redirect that replaces every URL with the same gate.

findings.summary: Transport cookies and key response defenses are misconfigured.
findings.evidence: Headers are missing CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. The session and XSRF cookies are not Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure and appropriate SameSite values on cookies; deploy HSTS, a nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, and explicit referrer/permission policies.

findings.summary: Third-party analytics and advertising run before a consent decision.
findings.evidence: Before any choice, the page contacted eight third-party origins and sent a Matomo analytics request. The notice advertises 1,874 partners.
findings.suggestedFix: Default optional categories off and do not load analytics, advertising, or partner resources until valid consent; minimise partner scope.

findings.summary: Account creation is password-only and lacks modern authentication assistance.
findings.evidence: The signup template has two password fields, no passkey/WebAuthn surface, and no autocomplete tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys for registration/sign-in and retain a well-assisted fallback with correct autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defense-in-depth is incomplete.
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; only X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors in CSP, HSTS, a strict referrer policy, a least-privilege permissions policy, and evaluate Trusted Types for script sinks.

findings.summary: Core public content is unavailable without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: The crawler view follows a noscript redirect and displays only “You must enable JavaScript,” while the browser view contains the listing/detail content.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the safe page shell and descriptive content; layer verification and playback on as progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: The app-like video experience declares a manifest but has no offline runtime.
findings.evidence: manifest.json declares standalone display and a start_url, but the service-worker probe found zero registrations and zero caches.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a minimal service worker and offline fallback for navigation and previously visited metadata, or remove standalone-app signals if installation is not intended.

findings.summary: An explicit localized URL does not remain localized in a clean browser session.
findings.evidence: Raw /es HTML is Spanish, but both rendered DOM captures finished at https://www.superporn.com/ with lang=en-GB and English content.
findings.suggestedFix: Respect explicit locale routes over geo/client-language redirects and preserve canonical/hreflang consistency after hydration.

findings.summary: The consent wording and behavior undermine an informed choice.
findings.evidence: The blocking copy states that accessing confirms acceptance of all cookies while also showing Decline All, and optional third parties already run before a decision.
findings.suggestedFix: Separate age confirmation from consent, use neutral language and equal choices, and block optional processing until opt-in.

findings.summary: Signup validation is not surfaced accessibly.
findings.evidence: An empty submit attempt produced no live error, aria-invalid state, native message, or focus movement.
findings.suggestedFix: Add native required/type constraints and accessible after-interaction validation with an announced error summary.

findings.summary: Signup fields omit autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: Email, username, password, and repeated-password inputs all report an empty autocomplete value.
findings.suggestedFix: Use email, username, new-password and an appropriate confirmation strategy so password managers and autofill can assist.

findings.summary: The listing image pipeline does not consistently use responsive modern assets.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 48 images without srcset, six legacy-format images, and zero modern-format images among 96 elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP where beneficial with responsive srcset/sizes while retaining dimensions and lazy loading.

findings.summary: Background analytics and consent-vendor work starts before user intent.
findings.evidence: The first load fetches large vendor lists and sends analytics before a consent choice; 11 scripts transfer about 402KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay optional vendor lists, analytics, and advertising until consent or user intent, and batch essential telemetry.

findings.summary: Third-party code consumes a disproportionate share of the initial budget.
findings.evidence: Eight third-party origins are contacted; age, consent, ad and vendor-list resources are among the largest/slowest requests in the 921KB initial transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget and defer optional providers; retain only providers with demonstrated user value.

taskList.title: Separate age verification from consent and block optional third parties until opt-in
Restore secure transport headers and cookie attributes
Fix accessible names, focus visibility, targets, zoom and captions
Reduce LCP and remove unused or blocking CSS/JavaScript
Make public summaries and metadata survive without JavaScript
Implement accessible signup validation, autofill and passkeys
Stabilise the video player and modernise responsive assets
Respect color, motion and contrast preferences
Preserve explicit locale routes and complete installability
Modernise modal, component responsiveness and navigation cues
